page.overview:
Who is Nuclear Weapons Devil?

The の|Kakuheiki no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of nuclear weapons.

The Nuclear Weapons Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Nuclear Weapons Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point, prior to the events of Chainsaw Man, the Nuclear Weapons Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of nuclear weapons from the world. This causes one of the Horsemen, Yoru, to pursue the Chainsaw Man in order to make him vomit the Nuclear Weapons Devil back up.
